newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE INDEX PAST 300, FOREKS OVER 200.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE INDEX PAST 300, FOREKS OVER 200.

text.p: * Forekspank most active with 5.3 mln kroons traded at 201.80/202.40 vs 198.35 kroons after the release of new 1997 profit forecast of 96.4 mln kroons.
* Hansapank sees 4.1 mln kroons traded at 166.10/167.00 kroons vs 166.40 kroons.
* Dealers said prices were moving quickly on an active market but expect the rush to slow and prices to end stable, around Tuesday levels.
(See index on stock exchange web site: http://www.tse.ee/online/total.htm)
Early trade on the Tallinn stock exchange saw Forekspank and Hansapank shares rise rapidily with the bourse index clearing 300 points.
However, dealers expect prices to hold with no big gains by the end of trading.
"It was a very active morning with Hansapank leading and then Forekspank taking the lead after it released its revised 1997 profit forecast," one trader said.
"I can't see the prices staying this high and expect them to come down to hold with no big gains by the close," anther trader said.
Forekspank released its revised 1997 profit forecast of 96.4 million kroons but dealers said that it was a fair estimate, but there was an expectation of 100 million kroons for the year.
"This was less than some investors had expected, but it is still an acheivable number," one trader said.
Forekspank was on a spread of 202.60/203.45 kroons compared to 198.35 kroons on trade of 7.5 million kroons.
Hansapank was stable to higher at a spread of 166.00/167.00 kroons compared to 166.25 kroons in trade of 10.4 million kroons at 0842 GMT.
"There was still some buying orders at first, but the price rise has slowed," a dealer said.
In Helsinki, Hansapank was 0.50 Finnish markka higher on trade of 310,300 markka.
The free market was again dominated by trade in privatisation vouchers with 16.3 million kroons traded.
The securities saw another new high on a spread of 38.60/41.00 kroons versus 0.385 kroons.
